threads.body: `slack_escape_text` only escapes HTML entities, but Slack link text uses the `<url|text>` format where a `|` in the title will break the link (and newlines can also produce malformed/unreadable messages). Sanitize these characters before embedding PR titles into Slack link text.

         return
 
 
+def slack_escape_text(text: str) -> str:
+    return html.escape(text, quote=False)

threads.body: This change aims to make Slack notifications title-first, but the notification job typically reads `results` from the cached dashboard state (`stored_result`), and that state intentionally does not persist `pr_title` (see dashboard.py field schema notes). As a result `result.get("pr_title")` will usually be empty and the message will continue to show `PR #<n>` instead of the title.

threads.body: `slack_escape_link_text` currently only HTML-escapes. In Slack’s `<url|text>` link syntax, an unescaped `|` in the PR title will break the link label (and newlines can make the message malformed/unreadable). Sanitize these characters before embedding titles into the link text.
